author: PissGod
quote:
30fps, **** story, horribly bugs, and 13 years of waiting. I don't have enough time to nitpick what I don't like about the game, but people are just throwing 10s around like they're monkeys throwing their feces around. Good graphics doesn't equal a good game, we've been through this. **** endings and even **** characters. My mentally stunted brother bought the game and I've forced myself to play it so I can make as accurate of a review as possible according to my experience, but it gets to a point. I don't give a **** if the main character is female or Jason is a cuck, they're annoying, boring characters and the only enjoyable parts are when you avoid the story.

I'd give it a 4 if not for the troons giving this game a 10 without as second thought as much as the goyim putting a 0 without actually having played the game past 10 hours. At least the negative reviews are honest, but that's also inflating the score since the bots are skewed in the game's favor
